com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick

Class IntradayHistoricalTickRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick.DefaultHistoricalTickRequest
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.tick.IntradayHistoricalTickRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HistoricalTickRequest, TurnAroundAware

    public class IntradayHistoricalTickRequest
extends DefaultHistoricalTickRequest
implements HistoricalTickRequest
    This is a default implementation to make a HistoricalTickRequest.PERIOD.INTRADAY request using TickHistoryManager.
    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

    • Constructor Detail

      • IntradayHistoricalTickRequest

        public IntradayHistoricalTickRequest(java.lang.Long turnAround,
                                     java.lang.Integer intradayBarLength)
        The bar length in minutes is a required field in addition to turnaround value. By default, it initializes the class with a period of intraday.
        Parameters:
        turnAround - TurnAround value.
        intradayBarLength - BarLength in minutes. e.g. 1, 5, 30 etc.
        See Also:
        TurnAroundAware.setTurnAround(Long), HistoricalTickRequest.setIntradayBarLength(Integer)
